title: Present Continuous
subtitle: Things happening now
review: Written by Claude. Check the Burmese, Spanish, Hindi and Vietnamese (explanations and scene translations) and the answers. No pictures or audio yet.
intro: Lucas is working, the TV is helping and the rice is certainly not burning. Four short scenes, then the rule, the mistakes to watch for, practice and a quiz.
clips: You are watching TV. I hear it.
I am working. The TV is helping.
It is not burning. It is cooking.
Take an umbrella. It is raining.
They aren't running. They are walking fast.
I'm not getting wet. I am washing my hair.
Yes. I am sleeping and talking.
She is sleeping too. Learn from her.

q.my: ဇာတ်ကွက် ၁ တွင် ကြိယာရှေ့၌ ဘာစကားလုံးများ ပါသလဲ။ ကြိယာအဆုံး၌ ဘာပါသလဲ။
q.en: Scene 1: which small words come before the verb? What is on the end of the verb?
q.es: Escena 1: ¿qué palabras pequeñas van antes del verbo? ¿Qué hay al final del verbo?
q.vi: Cảnh 1: trước động từ có những từ nhỏ nào? Cuối động từ có gì?
q.hi: दृश्य 1: क्रिया से पहले कौन से छोटे शब्द आते हैं? क्रिया के अंत में क्या है?

a.en: [[am]] / [[is]] / [[are]] before it, and [[-ing]] on the end.

q.my: ဇာတ်ကွက် ၃ တွင် 'မဟုတ်' ဟု ဘယ်လို ပြောသလဲ။
q.vi: Cảnh 3: họ nói 'không' như thế nào?

q.my: ဇာတ်ကွက် ၄ ၏ မေးခွန်းများတွင် are / is သည် ဘယ်နေရာ ရောက်သွားသလဲ။
q.en: Scene 4: where do are / is go in a question?
q.es: Escena 4: ¿dónde van are / is en una pregunta?
q.vi: Cảnh 4: trong câu hỏi, are / is đứng ở đâu?
q.hi: दृश्य 4: प्रश्न में are / is कहाँ जाते हैं?

a.my: ကတ္တား၏ ရှေ့သို့ ရောက်သွားသည်။ [[Are]] you sleeping? What [[is]] the cat doing?
a.en: Before the subject. [[Are]] you sleeping? What [[is]] the cat doing?
a.es: Antes del sujeto. [[Are]] you sleeping? What [[is]] the cat doing?
a.vi: Đứng trước chủ ngữ. [[Are]] you sleeping? What [[is]] the cat doing?
a.hi: कर्ता से पहले। [[Are]] you sleeping? What [[is]] the cat doing?

my: အခု ဖြစ်နေသော၊ လုပ်နေသော အရာအတွက် Present Continuous ကို သုံးသည်။
ပုံစံ − [[am / is / are]] + ကြိယာ[[-ing]]။
မြန်မာလို 'နေတယ်' နှင့် ဆင်တူသည်။ သို့သော် အင်္ဂလိပ်တွင် အပိုင်းနှစ်ပိုင်း လိုသည်။ [[am / is / are]] ကိုလည်း မဖြုတ်ရ၊ [[-ing]] ကိုလည်း မဖြုတ်ရ။
စာလုံးပေါင်း − make → mak[[ing]] (e ဖြုတ်)၊ run → run[[ning]]၊ get → get[[ting]] (ဗျည်း နှစ်ထပ်)။
en: Use the present continuous for things happening now.
You need both parts. Do not drop [[am / is / are]], and do not drop [[-ing]].
Question: move [[Am / Is / Are]] in front of the subject.
Spelling: make → mak[[ing]] (drop e), run → run[[ning]], get → get[[ting]] (double the last letter).
es: Usa el present continuous para lo que está pasando ahora.
Es como estar + -ando / -iendo: estoy trabajando = I [[am]] work[[ing]]. Pero el sujeto siempre se dice: [[It]] is raining.
Pregunta: [[Am / Is / Are]] va antes del sujeto.
Ortografía: make → mak[[ing]] (sin e), run → run[[ning]], get → get[[ting]] (doble consonante).
vi: Dùng thì hiện tại tiếp diễn cho việc đang xảy ra ngay bây giờ.
Cấu trúc: [[am / is / are]] + động từ[[-ing]].
Giống chữ 'đang' trong tiếng Việt, nhưng tiếng Anh cần cả hai phần. Đừng bỏ [[am / is / are]], và đừng bỏ [[-ing]].
Câu hỏi: đưa [[Am / Is / Are]] lên trước chủ ngữ.
Chính tả: make → mak[[ing]] (bỏ e), run → run[[ning]], get → get[[ting]] (gấp đôi phụ âm cuối).
hi: जो अभी हो रहा है, उसके लिए present continuous का प्रयोग करें।
यह हिंदी के 'रहा है / रही है / रहे हैं' जैसा है: मैं काम कर रहा हूँ = I [[am]] work[[ing]]. दोनों हिस्से ज़रूरी हैं।
प्रश्न: [[Am / Is / Are]] को कर्ता से पहले रखें। What [[are you]] doing? (What you are doing नहीं)
वर्तनी: make → mak[[ing]] (e हटाएँ), run → run[[ning]], get → get[[ting]] (आख़िरी अक्षर दो बार)।

intro.en: Say the [[-ing]] and the [['s]] / [['re]] clearly. Tap to listen.
intro.es: Pronuncia bien [[-ing]] y [['s]] / [['re]]. Toca para escuchar.
intro.vi: Đọc rõ [[-ing]] và [['s]] / [['re]]. Chạm để nghe.
intro.hi: [[-ing]] और [['s]] / [['re]] साफ़ बोलें। सुनने के लिए टैप करें।

note.es: En inglés hace falta el sujeto: it.

note.my: is ကို မဖြုတ်ပါနှင့်။
ကြိယာတွင် -ing ထည့်ပါ။
you / we / they နှင့် are ကို သုံးပါ။
note.en: Use are with you / we / they.
note.es: Con you / we / they se usa are.
note.vi: Với you / we / they, dùng are.
note.hi: you / we / they के साथ are लगाएँ।

note.my: မေးခွန်းတွင် are ကို you ၏ ရှေ့၌ ထားပါ။
note.en: In a question, are comes before you.
note.es: En la pregunta, are va antes de you.
note.vi: Trong câu hỏi, are đứng trước you.
note.hi: प्रश्न में are, you से पहले आता है।

note.my: isn't နောက်တွင်လည်း -ing လိုသည်။
note.es: Después de isn't también hace falta -ing.
